scope: Hash-pinned official Windows payloads, static user-mode wrapper and actual KMDF dispatch; no OEM code or assets reproduced.
method: leanrea static PE export/import/string inventory and targeted objdump control-flow inspection; zip members CRC and SHA-256 verified without execution
offset_convention: Driver and DLL locations are RVAs relative to each separately hashed PE image; file offsets are explicitly named.

control_center.package_verification_basis: Existing local download receipt; installer was not executed. Nested driver zip and its payloads were independently re-read in this audit.

openrevo_association.basis: data/openrevo-085-analysis.json; the prior fixed outer-executable inventory was reused, not freshly re-extracted in this audit
openrevo_association.different_payload: The separate embedded CLR helper at 0x6bb753 is not the native driver and is not assigned the DLL export ABI.
openrevo_association.limitation: Matching native driver bytes do not establish which user-mode handle path, buffer format or error handling OpenRevo actually uses.

device_binding.not_interchangeable: No ABI is assigned to a different binary, marketing model, \\.\UniwillAcpiDriver name, or generic WinRing0 device merely by similarity.
not_verified: Windows installation or loaded driver identity
Device ACL and elevated access on Windows

WriteEC.input_prefix: little-endian u32 address at offset 0, little-endian u32 data at offset 4; driver consumes only one data byte

wrapper.do_not_copy: Global 4 MiB buffers, byte-only decoding and ignored operation status are observations of this wrapper, not a recommended native client contract.

driver_dispatch.transfer_method: METHOD_BUFFERED (both IOCTL values have method bits 0)

zero_length_check.result: Either caller input or output length zero completes STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER (0xc000000d).

driver_dispatch.per_operation_length_validation: No EC-specific minimum size, firmware DataLength bound against caller output length, or response Count/returned-size validation was found. Nonzero acceptance is not proof that undersized buffers are safe.

read.success_checks: Nonnegative ACPI status, output signature 0x426f6541 and first argument Type==0 (integer).
read.output_copy_length: Variable u16 ACPI Argument[0].DataLength, read at RVA 0x22f2; passed as both memcpy_s destination size and count. Not a fixed one-byte store.
read.failure: Negative ACPI status or invalid output signature/type returns from helper without writing caller output.

write.output_copy_length: Variable u16 first integer argument DataLength if ACPI reports such a return; a valid EC write is not proven by output prefix.

initialization_helper.effect: Only advances local pointer/length copies; contains no caller-buffer dereference store. Does not clear METHOD_BUFFERED input/output storage.

completion.information: Original caller OutputBufferLength, not the number of bytes copied by ECRR/ECRW.
completion.status: STATUS_SUCCESS (0) after shared completion path, including negative EC helper status.

driver_dispatch.conclusion: DeviceIoControl success and BytesReturned cannot serve as an EC write acknowledgement or independently validate an EC read.

access_bits.effect: Even the ECRR read IOCTL requires a handle opened with write access. This is not proof that an ordinary user is authorized: the actual device ACL remains unverified.

strict_native_read_candidate.status: Static fail-closed candidate; not implemented or runtime-accepted by this receipt.

firmware_basis.method: MRO07 ECRR at DSL line 125737 calls the byte-read MMRW branch; the qualified firmware returns an integer in 0..255.

strict_native_read_candidate.dll_byte_only_ambiguity: For address 0x074e, failed ECRR can retain input DWORD 0x0000074e. The DLL reads only low byte 0x4e, indistinguishable from a successful byte value 0x4e.
strict_native_read_candidate.full_dword_distinction: A native client can inspect the complete little-endian DWORD rather than truncating: an unchanged 0x0000074e exceeds 255 and must be rejected; a correctly copied ULONG byte value 0x0000004e is different. The two cases are not indistinguishable in a full-buffer decoder.
requirements: Bind exact qualified device, driver hash/version and firmware before assigning ECRR byte semantics.
Require output prefix to satisfy the complete ULONG byte range; reject unchanged address echo, malformed upper bytes and uncertain response.
Preserve unknown/failure status; never claim successful restoration solely from DeviceIoControl success or the byte-only DLL getter.
Do not infer a smaller safe native buffer from the missing driver checks; validate the full native allocation/guard contract before runtime use.
limitations: The driver copies response DataLength, not a fixed ULONG; actual Windows response length and guard behavior remain unobserved.
The greater-than-255 address-echo distinction does not generalize to addresses 0..255.
A user-mode mutex cannot exclude the original OEM service or other kernel/firmware writers.

implementation_entry.first_oem_capability: Qualified FnLock Boolean only after strict read and restricted Windows elevation are implemented and accepted.

fixed_fn_evidence.independent_linux_reference: src/uniwill_interfaces.h and src/uniwill_keyboard.h fn_lock masked update

implementation_entry.required_boundary: Existing non-Linux privilege fallback directly calls Service; it must not silently become an elevated OEM control implementation. Add a fixed, authenticated Windows helper and fresh typed plan validation together with any writable backend.
not_enabled: arbitrary raw register or IOCTL API
charging thresholds or modes via assumed SMAPC layout
keyboard HID reports inferred from VID/PID or imports

official_protocol_references.purpose: METHOD_BUFFERED shares the input/output system buffer.
Integer method arguments use ULONG; this does not prove the actual length produced on the untested Windows target.
IOCTL access bits require the corresponding rights on the device handle, including read operations whose vendor code requests FILE_WRITE_DATA.

private_artifacts: console/.local-tests/windows-ec-abi-51 (ignored): exact driver payloads, disassembly, source provenance and independent dispatch analysis; no vendor code is committed.

offline_validation.scope: Static PE byte/control-flow consistency checks only; no hardware emulation or runtime protocol success is claimed.
